name: Gmail — Send
author: hearth-team
description: Send email through your Gmail account via Google OAuth. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.send scope — this skill can compose and send mail but physically cannot read your inbox. Pair with Gmail — Read if your agent also needs inbox visibility.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: From your Google Cloud project (APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs). Shared across all Google Workspace skills — same client for Gmail Send, Gmail Read, Google Calendar, etc.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: Paired with the client ID above. Stored encrypted in your vault.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail send refresh token
vault_inputs.help: Obtained via the OAuth consent flow with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send`. Generate at https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground (paste your client ID/secret, select Gmail API v1 → gmail.send, exchange for refresh token). Use a DIFFERENT token from the read skill — minimum-privilege isolation.

vault_inputs.label: From name (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Display name shown to recipients. Leave blank to use just the email address.
